values.title: 2026 Fall Calculus A2 Retake and Makeup Exam Notice
values.jd: Students on the Calculus A2 retake list may take the makeup exam; the exam will be held from 19:30 to 21:30 on 2026-09-16, and the individual exam room and seat are subject to the latest seating chart.
